summary: Phase 4 loyalty (parent visibility + admin settings/ledger UI) tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed. Frontend: parent /profile loyalty tab renders balance (12 نقطة, 0.12 JD) and Phase-3 seed history (PK-H-SMOKE-88767). Admin /admin Settings → الولاء subtab loads with all expected testids (toggle, earn-mode, points_per_jd, fixed_points, save, ledger card, refresh, row, prev/next). Staff /staff page contains zero admin loyalty UI — strict role separation honoured. Earn-flow regression verified at policy roundtrip level (PUT points_per_jd=2 then GET returns 2). Defaults restored at end.
critical_code_review_comments: Earn-flow regression was tested at the policy-persistence layer (PUT /api/admin/loyalty/settings echoes + GET roundtrip). A live staff QR check-in earn (e.g. amount=10, points_per_jd=2 → +20 points) was not exercised because creating a fresh paid hourly booking + valid QR was outside the scope of these endpoints. Recommend a follow-up integration test that walks bookings → payment → /api/staff/qr/checkin → balance delta if a regression slips in.

loyalty.js still uses Mongo transactions on the WRITE paths (awardPoints / redeemPoints). On standalone Mongo this would 500. Reads were fixed for Phase 4, but the next phase that calls awardPoints again on a standalone replica-less Mongo will fail. Consider a transaction-aware fallback or `supportsTransactions()` guard before startTransaction(). The util already imports `supportsTransactions` but never uses it.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a TEST_staff_<uuid>@peekaboo.com staff user via POST/DELETE /api/admin/staff to verify staff role is also blocked from admin loyalty endpoints. No persistent test data left behind. Loyalty policy left at defaults {enabled:true, earn_mode:'per_jd', points_per_jd:1, fixed_points_per_visit:10}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 (visibility + admin settings/ledger) ships clean. Frontend AuthContext key is `peekaboo_token` (not `token`) — use that for localStorage seeding in Playwright. Admin loyalty UI lives at /admin → الإعدادات sidebar → الولاء subtab. Parent loyalty UI is the `tab-loyalty` Tab in /profile. Phase-3 seed entry visible: parent has 12 points from PK-H-SMOKE-88767. Redemption is explicitly NOT implemented yet — future testing should not expect redeem endpoints/UI.
